cues.en: Welcome to Section four Performance Metrics for Fraud Detection.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到第四章：詐欺偵測的效能指標。

cues.en: This is Lecture 16 Implementing performance metrics in scikit Learn.
cues.zh: 這是第十六堂課：在 scikit-learn 中實作效能指標。

cues.en: So I've trained a version of the Xgboost classifier that we used previously, and it was the optimal solution.
cues.zh: 我訓練了先前使用的 XGBoost 分類器，也就是當時的最佳方案。

cues.en: And I've printed out a confusion matrix as we've seen a few times.
cues.zh: 並輸出我們已經看過幾次的混淆矩陣。

cues.en: Then beyond the confusion matrix itself, there are a lot of classification metrics that are important
cues.zh: 除了混淆矩陣本身以外，還有許多重要的分類指標，

cues.en: and tell us a different story about the classification performance of your model.
cues.zh: 能從不同角度說明模型的分類效能。

cues.en: So we're going to go through a few of those, but ultimately they are largely derived from the performance of the the classification or the confusion matrix itself.
cues.zh: 接下來會介紹其中幾種，但大多數都是從分類結果，也就是混淆矩陣衍生出來的。

cues.en: So within scikit learn within the metrics section of the API, we've got access to quite a few different scores and I'm going to go through a few of those.
cues.zh: 在 scikit-learn 的 metrics API 中，可以使用許多不同的評分函式，現在來看其中幾個。

cues.en: Now we're going to start with precision, where precision is the proportion of correctly predicted fraudulent
cues.zh: 先從精確率開始，它是所有被預測為詐欺的案例中，

cues.en: instances amongst all instances predicted as fraud.
cues.zh: 真正被正確預測為詐欺的比例。

cues.en: So for this model above, if we look at it here, we can see that it's the number of true positives,
cues.zh: 以上面的模型為例，就是取真陽性的數量，

cues.en: that's the number of correctly predicted fraud over the total number of.
cues.zh: 也就是正確預測出的詐欺筆數，除以全部

cues.en: Records predicted as fraud, which would be the sum of that and that so 43 over three plus 43 gives us 0.934, which is our precision.
cues.zh: 被預測為詐欺的筆數，也就是這兩格相加；43 除以 3 加 43，得到 0.934，也就是精確率。

cues.en: And we can also work that out using scikit learn.
cues.zh: 也可以使用 scikit-learn 來計算。

cues.en: So if we've got our predictions from the model and we've got our ground truth for the test sets, we
cues.zh: 只要取得模型的預測結果，以及測試集的真實標籤，

cues.en: can supply them both to precision score and then we're going to get the output, which is useful.
cues.zh: 把兩者傳入 precision_score，就能得到結果，非常方便。

cues.en: All right, So that's one way of looking at it.
cues.zh: 好，這是一種觀察角度。

cues.en: The next way of looking at the performance of your model would be to consider recall, which is the
cues.zh: 下一種評估模型效能的方式，是召回率，也就是

cues.en: performance or rather the proportion of the fraudulent instances that are successfully predicted.
cues.zh: 所有詐欺案例中，被成功預測出來的比例。

cues.en: So that's the total number of ground truth fraud that you were able to detect and its true positives over true positives plus false negatives.
cues.zh: 它反映真實詐欺案例中有多少被抓到，公式是真陽性除以真陽性加偽陰性。

cues.en: So its true positives plus or rather over the number of true positives and false negatives.
cues.zh: 也就是用真陽性，除以真陽性與偽陰性的總和。

cues.en: The false negatives are the fraudulent instances that we weren't able to detect, and obviously our true positives were the ones that we were able to detect.
cues.zh: 偽陰性是沒能偵測到的詐欺案例，真陽性則是成功偵測到的案例。

cues.en: So it's essentially the the relationship between those two.
cues.zh: 因此，它本質上是在看兩者之間的關係。

cues.en: And again, we can work that out with scikit learn and we get a value of 87.7%.
cues.zh: 同樣可以用 scikit-learn 計算，這裡得到 87.7%。

cues.en: Right then F one score is another metric that's frequently cited within the literature on fraud detection,
cues.zh: 接著是 F1 分數，這也是詐欺偵測文獻中經常提到的指標，

cues.en: and that's effectively the harmonic balance or the harmonic mean between these two.
cues.zh: 本質上是這兩者的調和平均數。

cues.en: So precision and recall and we can weighted more towards precision and recall if need be.
cues.zh: 也就是精確率與召回率，必要時也可以讓權重更偏向其中一個。

cues.en: There's a particular implementation called F beta where that beta weighting, we can dial it up and
cues.zh: 有一種稱為 Fβ 的實作，可以調高或調低 β 的權重，

cues.en: down depending on whether we want to bias the score more towards precision or recall.
cues.zh: 依需求讓分數更偏重精確率或召回率。

cues.en: But if we just look at the F one score, which is the perfect kind of balance between the two, this is the formula for it.
cues.zh: 但如果只看 F1 分數，它是在兩者間取得平衡，公式就是這個。

cues.en: We can actually take the values for precision and recall that we've already calculated.
cues.zh: 取出先前已經計算好的精確率與召回率，

cues.en: We can populate the formula and we can then obviously get a results.
cues.zh: 代入公式，就能得到結果。

cues.en: We can work that out analytically.
cues.zh: 我們可以直接依公式計算。

cues.en: And again, we can also use the implementation directly from scikit learn by just presenting the ground truth as well as the predictions.
cues.zh: 同樣也能直接使用 scikit-learn 的實作，傳入真實標籤與預測結果即可。

cues.en: Then another well understood metric is the accuracy or sometimes known as AUC, which is the area under
cues.zh: 另一個常用指標是 AUC，也就是

cues.en: the receiver operating characteristic curve.
cues.zh: 接收者操作特徵曲線之下的面積。

cues.en: And that's effectively a plot between the true positive rate, which is recall and the false positive rate.
cues.zh: 這張圖呈現真陽性率，也就是召回率，與偽陽性率之間的關係。

cues.en: And that looks at various classification thresholds.
cues.zh: 它會考慮各種不同的分類門檻。

cues.en: Like I mentioned, by default, your classifier is likely to generate a classification threshold of 50%.
cues.zh: 如前所述，分類器的預設分類門檻通常是 50%。

cues.en: So if the, you know, the probability of that prediction is above 50%, then it will be a 1 or 0 and
cues.zh: 因此，如果某筆預測的機率高於 50%，就會據此判斷為 1 或 0，

cues.en: that kind of thing.
cues.zh: 大致就是這個意思。

cues.en: But that classification threshold, we can actually change.
cues.zh: 不過，分類門檻其實可以改變。

cues.en: We have the ability to manipulate it to actually improve our classification performance if we'd like.
cues.zh: 如果需要，我們可以調整它，以改善分類效能。

cues.en: So we can say anything above 90%.
cues.zh: 例如，可以說凡是高於 90% 的，

cues.en: That's a positive prediction.
cues.zh: 就預測為正類。

cues.en: Anything below 90%, that's a negative prediction and there's some flexibility there.
cues.zh: 低於 90% 的則預測為負類，這方面是有彈性的。

cues.en: So what this model does is it iterates through all all of those possible classification thresholds and
cues.zh: 這個方法會遍歷所有可能的分類門檻，

cues.en: then it looks at the relationship between the recall, our true positive rate and false positive rate at each of those classification thresholds.
cues.zh: 查看各個門檻下，召回率，也就是真陽性率，與偽陽性率之間的關係。

cues.en: And then it calculates the area under that that curve of the of that relationship.
cues.zh: 接著，計算這段關係所形成的曲線下面積。

cues.en: And if you want to understand what false positive rate represents, it's the number of false positives over the sum of our false positives and our true negatives.
cues.zh: 如果想知道偽陽性率代表什麼，公式是偽陽性除以偽陽性加真陰性的總和。

cues.en: And it's quite a good, you know, approach for determining the overall performance of our model because
cues.zh: 這是衡量模型整體效能的好方法，因為

cues.en: we don't know at a start how we are going to calibrate our classification threshold because it's something
cues.zh: 一開始我們並不知道該如何設定分類門檻；

cues.en: we can manipulate out of the box if it's 50.
cues.zh: 預設雖然是 50%，但仍可以調整。

cues.en: But maybe 80, maybe 90% is our optimal threshold.
cues.zh: 最佳門檻也許是 80%，也許是 90%。

cues.en: But this gives us a good sense of the overall performance of our classifier.
cues.zh: 而這個指標能讓我們掌握分類器的整體表現。

cues.en: Then another metric that's probably better suited to fraud detection is the AEW PRC, which is the area
cues.zh: 另一個可能更適合詐欺偵測的指標，是 AUPRC，也就是

cues.en: under the precision recall curve.
cues.zh: 精確率－召回率曲線下面積。

cues.en: And that's a better alternative to AUC as it's.
cues.zh: 它是 ROC AUC 的一種較好替代選擇，因為

cues.en: Does not includes the true negatives, which influences the scores significantly in highly imbalanced data.
cues.zh: 它不包含真陰性，而在高度不平衡的資料中，真陰性會明顯影響分數。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧。

cues.en: So the number of true negatives is the number of non fraudulent transactions that we correctly detect
cues.zh: 真陰性就是我們正確辨識為非詐欺的

cues.en: as non fraudulent transactions because of the magnitude of that number and because of the class imbalance
cues.zh: 非詐欺交易數量。由於這個數量很大，而且類別不平衡，

cues.en: that throws off AUC in some sense, because you can see the number of true negatives is present within
cues.zh: 某種程度上會影響 AUC 的判讀，因為真陰性存在於

cues.en: these formulas, within the AUC formula, whereas the PRC doesn't include true negatives.
cues.zh: ROC AUC 所用的相關公式中，但 PRC 不包含真陰性。

cues.en: So that also looks at the area under the curve and the relationship between precision and recall at various classification thresholds.
cues.zh: 因此，它也是觀察不同分類門檻下，精確率與召回率的關係，並計算曲線下面積。

cues.en: We can implement it again with scikit learn and we get a score of 0.82.
cues.zh: 同樣可以用 scikit-learn 實作，這裡得到 0.82。

cues.en: So typically this is a much better metric to use to evaluate different models in a fraud detection context.
cues.zh: 所以在詐欺偵測情境中，用它來評估不同模型通常更合適。

cues.en: Because of the severe class imbalance.
cues.zh: 原因就是類別嚴重不平衡。

cues.en: Then lastly, a nice tool that scikit learn does provide is the classification report, and that merely
cues.zh: 最後，scikit-learn 還提供一個很方便的工具，叫做 classification_report，

cues.en: summarizes the classification metrics at the class as well as at the overall level.
cues.zh: 用來彙整各類別，以及整體層級的分類指標。

cues.en: So it will tell you what the precision, what the recall is, what the F1 score is by class.
cues.zh: 它會列出各個類別的精確率、召回率與 F1 分數。

cues.en: So for the negative class and the positive class, it will tell you the number of records within that class and then it also gives you the overall score.
cues.zh: 也就是針對負類與正類，列出該類別的紀錄數量，並提供整體分數。

cues.en: So like the overall accuracy, etcetera at the macro level as well as at the weighted level.
cues.zh: 例如整體準確率，以及 macro average 與 weighted average 等彙整結果。
